Detailed in-game guide for Personnel Management 1.1.5.0.

Quick start and controls|Open Personnel Management with Ctrl + M. Use the menu bar to switch between Overview, Applicants, Employees, Training, Settings and Help. On person pages, use A/D or Left/Right to change entries. Space confirms an action and Esc goes back. Press T for transport priorities and G for open wage requests.

Applicants and hiring|A new save starts with four applicants, and no more than eight may be available at once. Every applicant has experience, reliability, loyalty, a wage request and possibly specializations. Open an applicant profile and confirm hiring. The new employee then permanently belongs to the farm that hired them.

Employees and attributes|Experience, reliability and loyalty range from 0 to 100. Experience affects work speed, consumption and wear. Reliability affects interruptions, sickness and the risk of an early job abort. Loyalty influences wage requests and possible resignations. The employee page also shows status, wage, specializations, job statistics and the personal chronicle.

Work and development|Starting a normal AI or Courseplay job opens employee selection. Only available employees from the responsible farm can be chosen, and an employee can run only one job at a time. Work time increases experience and may develop matching specializations. Completed jobs, work time and important events are recorded for the employee.

Wages|Wages are charged at the month change. Actual costs depend on days per month, economic difficulty and the mod settings. Employees may request a raise. Open requests must be accepted or declined within their deadline and may affect loyalty.

Training|Employees can be trained according to the available offers. Training can begin only at the start of a month, costs money and blocks the employee from other jobs until month end. Successful training improves the selected specialization. Available offers and previous training are shown in the Training and Employee areas.

Resignation, dismissal and retirement|Dismissals, resignations and retirement do not always take effect immediately. Pending employment endings are completed at the month change according to their notice periods. An employee currently working cannot be dismissed immediately. Upcoming changes appear in the employee status and chronicle.

AutoDrive and Courseplay|For AutoDrive, enable employees as transport drivers under Employees / Transport and sort their priority. AutoDrive automatically uses the first available employee in that list and blocks the start when none is available. A normal Courseplay start opens employee selection. If Courseplay starts automatically after an AutoDrive trip, no new selection appears: the vehicle keeps its AutoDrive driver. With multiple vehicles, each vehicle must retain its own employee.

Multiplayer and savegames|Personnel, applicants, settings and active assignments are managed separately for each farm. In multiplayer, the server validates every change and only authorized farm managers may manage their personnel. Data is synchronized with clients and stored in helperPersonnel.xml inside the savegame. Employees and active assignments are restored when loading whenever possible.

Quick start and controls

Personnel Management replaces anonymous AI helpers with named applicants and employees. Every employee develops over time, receives a monthly wage and has individual experience, reliability, loyalty and specializations. Open the menu with Ctrl + M. It contains Overview, Applicants, Employees, Training, Settings and Help. Change person with A/D or Left/Right; confirm with Space or a click; return with Esc. T opens transport priority and G wage requests. In Help, Left/Right changes between contents and article, Up/Down selects or scrolls, and Page Up/Down moves by a page.
Overview and personnel status

The Overview summarizes the farm: employee, availability and applicant counts plus employer reputation are shown first. Active jobs list the person, vehicle, implement and activity. Changes only lists relevant personnel events: employer reputation, experience, reliability, loyalty, age or specialization. Each entry names cause, affected person and effect; a multi-line entry remains one notification. Monthly Report and Total show current and lifetime figures. Use this page for planning; decisions and personal history belong to the specialist pages.
Applicant market and hiring

All applicants are generated in a global market. The employer’s reputation then determines which farms an applicant is offered to. This is why farms may receive different offers; if the same person is offered to multiple farms, they have the same master data, values, and initial value range at every farm. As soon as one farm hires the person, they disappear from all other farms. At the start, experience, reliability, loyalty, rank, and salary expectations remain hidden. For each applicant, exactly one of these three values is visible as a randomly placed range of 30 percentage points. The true value always lies within that range, though not necessarily in the middle. Name, age, professional background, resume, and specializations remain visible. A job interview consists of no more than three questions. The first question about an unknown value reveals a 30-point range; asking again narrows it to 15 points, and a third question reveals the exact value. Values already known cannot be selected again. The interview can be paused and resumed later at the same point. The salary expectation becomes visible with the last answer.
Employee profile, values and status

Experience, reliability, and loyalty each range from 0 to 100. As long as job interviews are active, these values are displayed for applicants only based on the known status of the interview. Rank depends solely on experience and therefore appears only once the exact experience value is known. After hiring, any unknown values remain hidden for the time being. During actual assignments, the employee gains active experience in real time. After a duration set for each person—between 20 and 35 minutes—all three values become fully known. Breaks and periods without an active assignment do not count. Progress is saved in the game score. Experience determines work speed, additional wear and tear, and additional consumption. Reliability influences short-term performance drops, illness, monthly development, and the risk of mission termination. Loyalty describes the employee’s commitment to the company and influences warnings, salary disputes, and voluntary resignations.
AI helpers, transport and FollowMe

Starting normal AI helper work opens employee selection. Only available employees can be selected; sickness, training and existing work block selection. A job is counted after 10 seconds. Practical specialization progress needs at least three minutes. T or the menu button opens transport priority. It defines which free employee is checked first for A-to-B work. FollowMe also uses employee selection and counts as transport work.
Experience and work effects

GAINING EXPERIENCE – Recorded work time creates experience; unused learning minutes carry over. A job can grant at most two points and a monthly cap applies. EFFECTS – Primary specialization adds 12 effective experience and secondary adds 6, up to 100. Speed = 70% + 30% × effective experience / 100. Extra wear is up to 15%; extra material and fuel use is up to 10% × missing effective experience × economy factor (0.75 / 1.00 / 1.25). LEARNING TIME AND MONTHLY CAP – Experience 0–24: 25 minutes and cap +1; 25–49: 50 and 0; 50–69: 100 and -1; 70–84: 220 and -2; 85–94: 540 and -3; 95–100: 1080 and -4. – Base cap by days/month: 1=1, 2=2, 3–4=3, 5–6=4, 7–9=5, 10–12=6, 13–15=7, 16–18=8, 19–21=9, 22–24=10, 25–27=11, 28=12; actual cap is never below 1.
Loyalty and employer reputation

Loyalty normally starts near 65. Wage paid with reputation at least 40: +1; payment pushes below zero: -2; farm already negative: -4; service 3/6/12/24 months: +1/+1/+2/+3; request accepted: +3; declined: -5, or -7 below 40 loyalty; open after grace month: -2 monthly. Resignation at loyalty 0–5: 35%, 6–9: 20%, 10–14: 10%. Night work 22:00–06:00 may cost up to 4 loyalty and 1–2 reputation from 120 minutes. Reputation starts at 60 and ranges 0–100.
Wages and requests

Base wage at 3 days/month: experience 0–44: 1,800–2,200; 45–74: 2,200–2,700; 75–100: 2,700–3,300. Reliability factor 0.94–1.06; applicant random factor 96–106%, reputation effect and specialization premiums +5% primary/+3% secondary. Monthly wage = base × month-length factor × economy factor, rounded to 10. Factors for 1–28 days: 0.58; 0.82; 1.00; 1.15; 1.29; 1.41; 1.53; 1.63; 1.73; 1.83; 1.91; 2.00; 2.08; 2.16; 2.24; 2.31; 2.38; 2.45; 2.52; 2.58; 2.65; 2.71; 2.77; 2.83; 2.89; 2.94; 3.00; 3.06. Skilled Worker/Professional may request a raise with 55–85% chance.

Eight categories: Tillage, Sowing, Fertilizing, Plant Protection, Harvest, Transport, Machine Care and Resource Saver. Progress is separate and parallel. Learning factor = 1 + (experience-50)/250 + (reliability-50)/300, clamped to 0.75–1.30. Thresholds by previously learned count: 240, 420, 600 and 780 minutes, then +180 each. Learned specializations remain permanent. At most two bonuses are active: primary +12 effective experience and +5% base wage, secondary +6 and +3%. Either or both slots may be inactive. A learned inactive specialization may be activated only once per employee and agricultural year March–February; deactivation does not consume this right.

Training starts only on the first day of a month; with one day/month until 12:00 inclusive. One course per employee and agricultural year March–February. The employee is blocked until month end and progress is credited only at completion. Offers may be unavailable and monthly prices vary ±20%. Cost = current monthly wage × category factor × monthly modifier. Factors: Tillage 75%, Sowing 90%, Fertilizing 90%, Plant Protection 100%, Harvest 110%, Transport 65%, Machine Care 120%, Resource Saver 120%. Learning is unlimited; only active bonuses are limited to two.
Dismissal, resignation and retirement

Dismissal requires confirmation. With 1 day/month the deadline is day 1 at 12:00; otherwise the end of ceiling(days/month ÷ 2). After the deadline, employment continues another month. Immediate effects: loyalty -40, reliability -25. The employee normally stays usable until effective month end. Each extra dismissal in the month costs another 4 reputation. Resignation is checked monthly at loyalty 0–14; a declined request may add 5 percentage points, effective at month end, reputation -10. Retirement checks begin at 55, rising to 100% at 70; employment ends at month end.
Statistics and chronicle

The personal chronicle records hiring, jobs, experience, reliability, loyalty, sickness, specialization, training, wage requests, transport, dismissal, resignation and retirement. Employee profiles show completed jobs, total work time and total wages paid. Overview totals include people hired, dismissed, resigned and retired for the farm. Historical values never stored by older versions cannot be fully reconstructed for people who already left.

Settings apply per savegame. Work performance: experience, speed, wear, consumables, fuel and reliability. Personnel development: personnel effects, loyalty and night work. Economy: economic effects, individual wages and standard monthly base wage from 100 to 100,000 in steps of 10. Disabling an effect does not retroactively rewrite saved personnel values. Key bindings can be changed in game settings.
Multiplayer and savegames

The "Job Interviews" setting applies per game session. If it is enabled, the hidden stats, interviews, and subsequent reveal take effect during the assignment period. If it is disabled, all applicant and employee stats are displayed in full as before. Only the server and authorized farm managers may change this setting. In multiplayer mode, the server decides on each question and synchronizes the interview progress. The first authorized farm manager to open the window conducts the interview. Other players from the same farm can watch live; their topic buttons remain disabled. If the conversation leader closes the window or loses their connection, another authorized farm manager can take over. Staff, applicants, assignments, salaries, training, hiring, and chronicles remain farm-specific. Global applicants can be offered to multiple farms, but their conversations are stored separately for each farm.
Hiring and first steps

In the "Applicant" tab, open the interview and select "Experience," "Reliability," or "Loyalty." The selected question and the answer will appear in the interview transcript. The interview ends after no more than three questions, and the salary expectation becomes visible. Decide whether to hire based on the known exact values, ranges, and remaining uncertainty. After hiring, values that have not been fully clarified initially remain at their last known level. Schedule actual assignments: After 20 to 35 minutes of active real-time work, the values are fully revealed. The employee must be available; illness, ongoing work, training, or a confirmed resignation may prevent selection. A hire improves the employer’s reputation by one point. Activities and specialization mapping

The mapping uses vehicle, implements and, where available, applied material. Material takes priority: seeds mean sowing; herbicide means plant protection; mineral or liquid fertilizer, slurry, digestate and manure mean fertilizing. Lime has no automatic learning-category mapping. Ploughs, cultivators, power harrows, disc harrows, rollers and mulchers are tillage. Seeders and planters are sowing. Sprayers without a clear material are fertilizing. Combines, headers, balers, mowers, forage wagons and pickups are harvest. Trailers and unloadable vehicles are transport. FollowMe also recognizes forage harvesters, potato and beet harvesters, tedders, windrowers, manure spreaders, slurry tanks, subsoilers, stone pickers, weeders and hoes. Mod vehicles can remain neutral when no unambiguous mapping exists. Machine Care lowers experience-based extra wear; Resource Saver lowers extra fuel and material use.
